label: Orrin
description: A steady build-up: trouble comes in waves, each a little bigger than the last, with calm between.
notes: RimWorld's Cassandra Classic. The cycle numbers are recalled, not read from the game's files: a big threat roughly every six days.

label: Maren
description: Long quiet spells and gentler trouble; good things come more often.
notes: RimWorld's Phoebe Chillax: about nine days between big threats. Recalled numbers.

label: Jinx
description: Anything can happen at any time; no rhythm, no build-up.
notes: RimWorld's Randy Random: every incident rolls on its own (a mean time between, in days), and each threat's points are scaled by a random factor. Misc 1.35 days is the wiki's figure; the rest are recalled.
